observation_semantics.deadline_index: Zero-based index of SELL decision close from full input first session 2019-12-31; -1 when flat.
observation_semantics.exit_pending: Latched from first SELL decision through failed executions; cleared only after SELL fill.
observation_semantics.renewal_signal: Current held parent+ready condition, plus high for qualified; can remain true during exit latch.
observation_semantics.renewal_applied: One-session event: deadline strictly increased; false during exit latch.
observation_semantics.cap_hit: One-session event: eligible non-latched proposed deadline exceeded entry+cap-1 and was clipped; can be true without applied renewal.
observation_semantics.holding_horizon: Original base h per renewal, not total maximum elapsed holding.
